subject: Geopolitics
title: The WTO and Its Crisis
description: A short lesson to help you apply The WTO and Its Crisis.

hook.text: The WTO was supposed to govern global trade.

buildup.text: Founded in 1995, the WTO set rules for 164 nations. Free trade was the gospel and tariffs were the sin.

discovery.text: The system worked when everyone was getting richer. But when China joined and won, losers questioned the rules.

twist.text: The US argued China gamed the system — subsidizing firms, stealing IP, and manipulating currency while WTO stood idle.

climax.text: Without a functioning WTO, trade becomes a jungle. Bilateral deals and tariff wars replace multilateral order.

punchline.text: Rules work until the biggest player stops following them.

quiz.question: Why has the WTO's dispute resolution mechanism been paralyzed?
options: Developing nations withdrew from the system
The US blocks the appointment of new judges
China refused to accept any rulings against it
